notes: Managed DSH manifest-build composition: workspace-write sandbox whose only enabled write tool is tool-fs; every other write/execute/spawn tool from the strict-plan patch stays disabled.

The per-task write manifest cannot be declared statically. It is injected by the generated patch insert config and pinned there by validate_manifest_build_dump against the caller's prepared manifest; the descriptor therefore only pins the source as per-task.
The dsh-write-guard plugin is materialized per task from WRITE_GUARD_FILES and mounted by absolute path with a prepend registration on fs/write-intent and fs/edit-intent.
